questions.prompt: What effect do increased compressed-air leaks have on a pneumatic system?
questions.answer: Higher energy costs and lower efficiency
options: Higher energy costs and lower efficiency
questions.explanation: Leaked compressed air wastes energy and can reduce tool efficiency and productivity.
